title: Faculty, lab and partner registry
description: ADNSU faculties, labs and industry partners in one place. Projects, students and resource requests link to these records; a record in use is archived, not deleted.

empty.noResultsHint: Change the search term or the status filter.
empty.facultiesHint: Add the pilot university's faculties so students, teams and projects can be linked to them.
empty.labsHint: Add the labs teams work in — trainings and resource requests link to them.
empty.partnersHint: Add candidate or active partners; projects and resource requests can link to them.

usage.intakeRequests: {count, plural, one {# preparation request} other {# preparation requests}}
usage.intakeMembers: {count, plural, one {# request member} other {# request members}}
usage.requests: {count, plural, one {# resource request} other {# resource requests}}
usage.openRequests: {count, plural, one {# open request} other {# open requests}}
usage.upcomingTrainings: {count, plural, one {# upcoming training} other {# upcoming trainings}}

faculty.dialogDescription: A faculty name must be unique within its university. The coordinator does not sign in — the field is for contact only.

lab.dialogDescription: Lab status is used when planning trainings: closed labs are not offered for new trainings.

partner.dialogDescription: Status tracks the partnership talks; the coordinator makes the decisions.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: The record will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone, but it stays in the audit log.

inUseBody.faculty: Records are still linked to this faculty, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead — history is kept and it is no longer offered for new links.
inUseBody.lab: Projects, trainings or resource requests are linked to this lab, so it cannot be deleted. Set its status to “Closed” instead — it will no longer be offered for new trainings.
inUseBody.partner: Projects or resource requests are linked to this partner, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead — history is kept.

fields.universityHint: The pilot university is selected by default.
fields.coordinatorHint: Name or contact; no system account needed.
fields.notesHint: Internal note, visible to coordinators only.
fields.facultyHint: Leave empty if the lab does not belong to a faculty.
fields.facultyNoneAvailable: No faculties registered for this university.
fields.contactHint: Person in charge, phone or e-mail.
fields.labStatusHint: “Closed” labs are not offered for new trainings.

errors.nameShort: The name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.nameLong: The name cannot be longer than 160 characters.
errors.nameTaken: A faculty with this name already exists at this university.
errors.partnerTaken: A partner with this name is already registered.
errors.universityLocked: Records are linked to this faculty — its university cannot be changed.
errors.facultyMismatch: The selected faculty does not belong to this university.
errors.notFound: Record not found — refresh the page.
errors.inUse: The record is in use and cannot be deleted.
errors.invalid: The data entered is not valid.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
